trends.title: 2026年10月彩妆趋势：Skin-first与护肤彩妆hybrids登顶，市场规模41.5亿美元
trends.summary: Simporter 2026年10月彩妆趋势显示，消费者偏好决定性转向skin-first，Skincare-Makeup Hybrids以AI评分92登顶当月第一趋势，Satin&Soft Matte(88)、High-Placement Blush(85)紧随；10月彩妆市场规模41.5亿美元，同比9月40.8亿增长，预计11月达43亿峰值。
trends.source_classify_note: Simporter美妆趋势数据平台（机构口径）。
trends.source_excerpt: Consumer preferences are decisively shifting towards 'skin-first' approaches, with Skincare-Makeup Hybrids (92) and Satin & Soft Matte Finishes (88) driving innovation. The makeup market demonstrated robust performance in October 2026, reaching $4.15 billion, a healthy increase from September's $4.08 billion.
trends.trend_direction: 上升（消费偏好与市场规模双增）
key_points: Skin-first审美成主导，护肤彩妆hybrids登顶（评分92）
Satin&Soft Matte(88)、High-Placement Blush(85)为次级趋势
10月彩妆市场41.5亿美元，环比+1.7%，11月预计43亿峰值
Medicube(95)等新兴品牌领跑hybrid品类

trends.title: 2026秋妆容趋势：Cloud skin与frosted finish走热，柔雾肤色+冷调唇成主线
trends.summary: Pinterest首份Beauty Trend Report显示2026秋季妆容向icy与romantic之间摆动：frosted makeup搜索+286%、cloud skin+153%、soft natural makeup+105%；blush偏好dusty rose/terracotta/peach（分别+189%/+164%/+148%），metallic lips+52%、pastel blue eyeshadow+51%，指向柔雾肤色与冷调妆效。
trends.source_excerpt: Frosted finishes and soft-focus colour feature prominently in make-up searches. Searches for 'frosted makeup' increased 286%, with smaller rises for 'metallic lips' at 52%, 'pastel blue eyeshadow' at 51% and 'silver eyeliner makeup' at 48%. Searches for 'cloud skin' increased 153%, while 'soft natural makeup looks' grew 105%.
key_points: cloud skin搜索+153%、soft natural makeup+105%
frosted makeup+286%，冷调微光妆效回潮
blush偏好dusty rose/terracotta/peach
metallic lips+52%、pastel blue eyeshadow+51%
